Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
1058 AM EDT Sat Oct 3 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 PM EDT THIS AFTERNOON...

.REST OF TODAY...NE winds 10 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt late this morning
and early afternoon. Waves 1 to 2 ft. A chance of showers late this
morning, then showers likely this afternoon. 
.TONIGHT...E winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. A chance of showers. 
.SUN...NE winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. Showers.
.SUN NIGHT...N winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. A chance of showers. 
.MON...NW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.MON NIGHT...N winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.TUE...N winds 10 to 15 kt...diminishing to around 5 kt. Waves 1 to
2 ft...subsiding to flat. 
.WED...S winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft.
